mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 5% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to expectations of tighter credit conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the mean of the prior 30 months (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months, labor market slack increases, reducing expected corporate profit growth and depressing S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (t-test p < 0.05) during such UNRATE conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in HOUST above 1,500 units indicate strengthening consumer demand, which elevates expected corporate earnings and drives a positive S&P 20-day forward return.
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, 20-day forward returns during such HOUST increases are not higher than the overall mean (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO below 112 (monthly) suggests supply-side contraction, raising uncertainty and depressing S&P 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: During INDPRO < 112 months, 20-day forward returns are not negatively different from the baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month, the 60-day S&P 500 forward return is expected to be negative due to reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05) during such FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in PAYEMS above 138,000 in a month is accompanied by a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as hiring momentum boosts earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the prior 30 months mean (p > 0.05) during such hiring surges.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in both GDPC1 and RSAFS above their 2022 Q4 averages are indicative of resilient demand, predicting a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
regime_hint: dual demand indicators above historical norms
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive or are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) during such dual proxy increases.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 5% for three consecutive months, supply-side pressures dominate, leading to a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as growth expectations fall.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05) during the three-month UNRATE rise.
